steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (They work well together... how many of them are there?)

steps.name: Fierce Animal
steps.text: (Growls)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hey, why did they stop?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Why are they looking for you?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'm Waai Fu. Even if they read my name like Huai Hu around here.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Waai Fu, Huai Hu... I'll remember.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I'm Jieyun.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I'll come back and find you.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Wait—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Strange girl...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Let's catch some bad people first.
The old man gazes over the map, drawing a course.
His gaze moves slowly. He knows how vast a distance every inch on the paper represents.
The tea on the table has long grown cold.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I didn't think you would enjoy our provincial Yumen tea, Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Everyone here drinks the same tea. So can I.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: This tea is Yin in nature. It's not ideal while the weather is cold.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Your knowledge is vast, but you don't pay enough attention to your health.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The others would be anxious if you fell ill.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Someone better will take my place, if I fall ill. Each generation is better than the one that came before. There is no single person whom Yan cannot do without.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: What is important is not one person, one generation, but the legacy.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Such has always been the way.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Legacy.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: A difficult concept for us to understand.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You've taught countless people who've contributed to Great Yan.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The army still uses the martial records left behind by the Record Keepers for training. I myself have received military instruction from you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: At the end of the day, I, we, our expertise, it was all learned from others.
Chongyue dumps the cold tea and pours a new cup of hot tea.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Since when have we become strangers?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I've never forgotten the times when we discussed matters of state over candlelight, and drew swords alongside one another.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: But where we stand has changed.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Excuse my impudence.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You didn't come just to talk about old times, did you?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I came to say goodbye.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Here I am.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Hello, Envoy Lin.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Wasn't it two days ago that we last saw each other?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: More has happened in two days than in the twenty years prior.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Now that I think about it, you did what you did that day not to help me, but to stop me from investigating.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I still helped you.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I had heard that the L.G.D. sent an acting inspector to oversee matters of public security when the two cities were docked.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I could not associate the commotion you caused at the market and the Sword Forge with the young girl who stands before me now.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Did you set your sights on me from the beginning?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: No, only just now.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I wasn't sure that all this was your doing, until you showed up.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You only suspected?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That was enough.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Your style is... unique.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I've always been like this. Did you want to say 'unscrupulous?'

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Could you really call all that you have done scrupulous?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Fair enough. But what specifically did you mean by 'all that?'

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Working with the Shanhaizhong, faking the bandit attack on the Messenger, then setting up an attack on me, making the fake Catastrophe data 'real.'

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Then you had someone else steal the Grandmaster's sword to muddy the waters.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: The theft of the sword was unexpected. Otherwise, last night would never have happened...

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But it is impressive that you've deduced the switching of the data.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Good thing you had enough decency to not actually kill the Messenger.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I have a question myself. Why?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I'm sure you already know the answer.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You wanted to cause a Catastrophe and destroy Yumen just because you had a grudge against the Lord Exorcist?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Zuo Xuanliao and us have been through more than hell and high water together. The word 'grudge' is far too light.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: And Zuo Xuanliao has taken us too lightly.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You are from Lungmen.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I've heard it's a good place. A prosperous one. I never had a chance to visit.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You've seen how things are at Yumen. Traveling through the desert all year long, risking Catastrophe to deliver important reports, trekking through nothing but sand for days in search of water... you've never experienced that.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Someone has to protect the borders, protect the nation.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Soldier or civilian, most Yumenites are not local. We left our homes to settle here, without a word of complaint.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Zuo Xuanliao should not forget that there are others who had a hand in Yumen becoming Yan's bulwark! Who does he think he is? Driving away those who have bled for Yumen?!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You misunderstood the Lord Exorcist.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Then why is the Grandmaster leaving Yumen?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What I can't understand is why you want to destroy the city that you've protected for so many years.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: How many Catastrophes do you think Yumen has encountered in its history?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: A single Catastrophe won't destroy Yumen. It will only unite its people!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: ...Madman.
Two young people cower in a corner of a warehouse, looking rather haggard.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: The Qis...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Where are the others? What about the soldiers and the Messenger?

steps.name: Young Bodyguard
steps.text: Old Meng from the Sword Forge let them go just now.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Thank goodness they're alright.

steps.name: Young Bodyguard
steps.text: M-Miss Du...

steps.name: Young Bodyguard
steps.text: I'm sorry, we didn't get the job done.

steps.name: Young Bodyguard
steps.text: The guys from the Sword Forge knocked us out before we even knew what was going on. We found ourselves in the warehouse by the time we came to.

steps.name: Young Bodyguard
steps.text: Why did they do that?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: It's a long story.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Come on, stop with the long face!

steps.name: Young Bodyguard
steps.text: B-But it's Xingyu Logistics's first job...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: We ran into something this big on our first job! That means we're meant for big things!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Now put yourself together and follow me!

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I have an idea of where the sword is.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You had an idea from the beginning.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Just a little private interest. I guess I couldn't keep it from you.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Everyone has private interests.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: That's fine, as long as it doesn't interfere with duty.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I have an idea whom to entrust the sword to. I just want to see the last trial through.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: With your permission, of course.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The goodbye you mentioned, it's more than just this.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The path ahead is unknown. Who knows if we'll meet again? A proper farewell is in order.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yumen is headed for the capital.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It is about to wake.
The old man turns around and once again casts his eyes towards the map. He sees and thinks about much on it.
He suddenly has a question, one that the 'Grand Tutor' would not have asked.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Do you have regrets?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Parting is a fact of life. Seeking perfection doesn't mean there won't be regrets.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But sometimes I feel that there just isn't much I can do.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Yumen started out as a fortress built for that hunt.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The hero of Yumen could have humble beginnings, or he could belong to one of the long-lived races, but the one thing he cannot be is the incarnation of a Feranmut.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: This is a secret that the Sui Regulator must protect at all costs.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: One cannot expect to be understood and accepted no matter where one goes...
The man walks slowly to the old man's side, and the two of them gaze silently at the depiction of mountains and rivers.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yumen will approach the capital in six months, barring any unexpected events.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The markings on the map are locations where civilians are expected to be evacuated prior to Yumen's arrival at the capital.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: If things get to that point, Yumen must be prepared to sacrifice itself to kill the bestial Sui. This is a price that Yan must pay.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The Shanhaizhong struck twenty years ago. Lord Exorcist came to me after things calmed down, before the Sui Regulator arrived.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: He realized then that the bestial Sui were a great potential threat to Yan. Yumen will someday return to its original battlefield.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: When it comes to that, Yumen cannot rely on me or the jianghu fighters. Everyone must go. This place that many people have called home will return to dust.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: People on the outside call the Lord Exorcist heartless, but there's so much that he cannot tell anyone.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: We had a group of common friends...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Those who carry heavy responsibilities cannot be trapped by private sentiment.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Twenty years of conflict. There were misunderstandings, and there were grudges, but there must be closure. This is something that I need to do myself.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: This is a private request. I dare not ask for your understanding.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Yet in some cases, an allowance can be made.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Shuo is part of that atrocity, but the people of Yan owe Chongyue a great debt.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: So what you mean is...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The Lord Exorcist has tasked you to ensure my safety.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: What danger is there to me, if you can protect Yumen?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Thank you.
The man turns and leaves the tent.
The old man nods slightly in his direction.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Lord Wei...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I can be of help in the hunt for the criminals.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will see you off.
The air feels dead, silent. The only sound is that of gravel as it falls on the roof.
The warehouse has no windows. Lin Yühsia listens intently for any sounds outside. Minute after minute passes. Have the Catastrophe clouds drawn closer?
The night winds blow stronger.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You look impatient, Miss Lin.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Thank you for chatting with this old man. Perhaps it's because you thought I may still have the real data collected by the Catastrophe Messenger.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Take it.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Why would you give it away for nothing?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It's too late for Yumen to avoid the Catastrophe now, even if the correct data reached the Imperial Astronomical Bureau.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I would like to make it clear that this plan was entirely my own. The folks who were taken into custody are innocent.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Good to see you still know what 'innocent' is, after putting an entire city's worth of people in danger.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: There is act of nature, and there is act of man. They should not be confused.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You must have other reasons for delaying me.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Of course. I would not simply waste time on a day like today.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I had promised to help an acquaintance leave the city, but I have no choice but to go back on that promise after what happened at the Sword Forge last night. I can only hope to draw more attention and make it easier for her to get out.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The sword thief? Didn't you say the theft was unexpected?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Astute as ever.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But this is a rather silly matter. Too silly to talk about.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Let those who should leave, leave. Let the debts that should be settled, be settled.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: You got what you came for, Miss Lin. You should leave.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: There was one thing you didn't catch.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It's not just Zuo Xuanliao I hold a grudge against.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I picked this time and place to settle another debt.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You hide well. You made us work to find you.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You turned your back on our partnership.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Weren't you trying to silence me when you went to the Sword Forge last night?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Get the data from the girl. Leave this one to me.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Aye.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Maybe you misunderstood.
The old man opens a bag on his belt and takes out an unremarkable black iron hammer.
He glares at the Shanhaizhong and speaks through clenched teeth.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Hide? I've been waiting for a chance to finish all of you off!
